title.narrative: Initiativ för att omforma maskulinitet och främja jämställdhet
The Catalyst Initiative: Transforming Masculinity, Accelerating Equality

description.narrative:
1. Deconstruction of dominant norms and increased self-awareness
Participants will critically deconstruct dominant, harmful masculine norms, recognize their impact, and demonstrate heightened awareness of how these norms have shaped their own identities, beliefs, and professional and personal behaviours.
2. Internalization of positive masculinity principles
Participants will internalize and articulate a framework of positive masculinity rooted in empathy, accountability, and shared power, equipping them to actively apply these principles over conditioned responses.
3. Active promotion of gender-transformative environments and programming
Participants will act as agents of change by modeling positive masculinity and practicing active allyship, demonstrably contributing to safer, more equitable, and collaborative work environments as well as more strategic and deliberate gender transformative programming.

Detta initiativ har vuxit fram genom ett års dialog mellan UNFPA och Sida om hur jämställdhet kan främjas på ett mer genomgripande sätt i utvecklings- och humanitära program. Arbetet har varit ett gemensamt utvecklingsarbete där experter från bland annat Equimundo och MenEngage Alliance har bidragit med kunskap och idéer. Initiativet bygger vidare på den tidigare Babakampanjen – ett ambassadlett initiativ som främjade vårdande faderskap och utmanade rigida könsroller. Det nya initiativet syftar till att främja positiva maskuliniteter bland manliga yrkesverksamma inom utvecklings-och humanitära sektorer, i syfte att påskynda framstegen mot jämställdhet

This initiative is a product of a yearlong dialogue between UNFPA and Sida on how to best promote a transformative approach to gender equality in development and humanitarian programs. It has been a cocreative process with inputs from experts such as Equimundo and MenEngage Alliance. The iniatiative would be building on the earlier Baba campaign – an Embassyled initiative that promoted nurturing fatherhood and challenged rigid gender roles – this catalyst new initiative aims to foster positive masculinities among male professionals in the development and humanitarian sectors to accelerate progress toward gender equality
